subject_line: Application for Generative AI Engineer — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am a Python Backend Developer focused on FastAPI and RAG pipelines. I am applying for this role because the requirement to build autonomous AI agents and RAG pipelines using LangChain and vector databases matches my recent work directly.

I built a production Generative AI resume builder using Python and FastAPI, implementing vector similarity search and JWT authentication to cover the backend and vector database requirements. I also developed an inventory management system using Node.js and PostgreSQL, handling REST APIs and database schema design.

I bring hands-on experience building practical AI products and RAG pipelines. Let's discuss how I can contribute to your team.
